jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious mission: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

More than 1/3 of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet. 10% of greenhouse gas emissions come from food waste and loss.

Through our marketplace app, we connect businesses that have unsold, surplus food, with consumers who can buy and enjoy it at ⅓ of retail value. We are on a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste: alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 120 million registered users and 180,000 active partners across 20 countries, have together already saved over 500 million meals from going to waste

In 2023, Too Good To Go was recognised on Fortune's acclaimed 'Change the World' list, named as one of Deloitte's 'Best Managed Companies' and won a coveted 'Cultural Impact Award' at the annual Apple App Store Awards.

The Role

We are building a brand-new engineering hub in London, and we are looking for foundational Backend Software Engineers to help us kick it off. This is a unique opportunity: you will be joining a completely new team, building a new hub from scratch, and working remotely from the rest of our global Tech organisation.

As an integral part of this new product team, you will help define, build, and deliver our product features. You will work towards specific outcomes with the freedom and responsibility to figure out the best way to achieve them together with your team. Your mission will be to help refine, design, implement, deliver, and maintain an international top-class product, ensuring quality, maintainability, and sustainability.

The Tech Stack

We have created a scalable Spring Boot Application running on Java 25 in Kubernetes, deployed in a multi-region setup in AWS. Developers are able to run a full development environment locally, which gives a great developer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve our backend services and infrastructure to stay ahead of our growth curve.

  • Develop exciting new features for our customers and businesses who partner with us.

  • Actively participate in your team’s agile development processes with a continuous improvement mindset.

  • Strive to deliver international top-class products with maximum quality, maintainability and scalability.

  • Take on additional tasks outside your current boundaries with help from your team to continue to grow and expand your skills.

The ideal candidate

  • A wealth of experience in Backend development with the Java ecosystem.

  • Proven production experience with Java, SpringBoot, MySQL, Message System & GIT.

  • Has worked with Domain Driven Design, and Clean, or Hexagonal Architecture.

  • Knowledge of AWS services (SQS, SNS, S3…), ElasticSearch, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Restful APIs.

  • Experience with building scalable solutions.

  • Enjoys actively participating in a cross-functional product team.

  • Takes pride in writing quality code.

Our Values

  • We Win Together

  • We Raise the Bar

  • We Keep It Simple

  • We Build A Legacy

  • We Care

What we have to offer 

  • A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company where you can see real and tangible impact in your role.

  • Working alongside an international community of users, partners and 1,200+ colleagues across 20 countries that are on the same important mission.

  • Personal and professional development opportunities in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • An inclusive company culture where you can bring your authentic self to work.

  • A strong, values-driven team culture where we celebrate successes and socialise with colleagues that care.

Benefits

WORK FLEXIBLY: 

  • Enjoy hybrid working from our great office (2 days per week in Shoreditch).

  • Extra parental leave and days off beyond local legislation and the option to take an extra week of unpaid leave.

  • Health insurance and pension plans.

  • Additional days off for significant life events.

CELEBRATE & SOCIALISE

  • Regular social events like summer and winter parties.

  • Coffee, snacks and fully-equipped kitchens.

  • Get to know our community with a monthly free Surprise Bag.

  • Paid volunteer time through our Shareback volunteering programme.

  • Women in the Workplace, P.R.I.D.E., People of Colour and Functionally Diverse Employee Resource Groups .

How to apply

We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.

Submit your CV and Cover letter in English.

Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Too Good To Go

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. 40% of all food produced in the world is wasted, contributing to 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions. We’re more than an app, we are a social impact company working across 20 countries to drive change through our marketplace app, educational tools, legislative work, and logistics initiatives.

Our community of 118 million registered users and 246,000 active partners, have together already prevented 443+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.198.000 tonnes of CO2e!

The Role

Too Good To Go is looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to help build, scale, and architect our data infrastructure, enabling our global mission to reduce food waste.

You would be part of the Platform team based in Copenhagen HQ. Data Platform enables multiple teams including Backend, ML, Analytics, and Marketing by helping them manage data infrastructure powering batch pipelines, live inference, and streaming initiatives across the company. In this role, you will operate as a technical anchor at the intersection of platform infrastructure and data engineering, scaling the ecosystem to meet the needs of the teams building on it. You will be responsible for designing, improving, and implementing reliable, robust data systems and the ingestion flows that feed both our backend app and our BI tools, supporting growth and better decisions across the company.

This is a senior role for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems, driving architectural vision, and mentoring others. You will work closely with analytics engineers, ML engineers, and product managers to build practical solutions for problems that don't have a standard answer, and to scale the platform that serves many teams.

Tech Stack

Our data stack includes AWS (Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, Firehose, S3, Glue, EMR, AppFlow), Airflow, Flink, dlt, dbt, and Metaflow, built and managed with Python and Terraform following GitOps principles. We also provide access to modern AI tools to boost engineering productivity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, architect, and maintain scalable data processing solutions with a focus on reusable infra systems, building services that enable external teams to power personalization, product discovery, lead generation, dynamic pricing, and BI dashboards.

  • Own the shared infrastructure that other teams build on, including ML workflows (Metaflow), the data processing platform (Glue, AppFlow, Airflow, Lambda), and data storage (Redshift, OpenSearch, RDS, S3).

  • Build self-service tooling and infrastructure standards so teams can deploy and operate their own pipelines independently.

  • Optimize system performance, efficiency, and infrastructure cost governance across our AWS data ecosystem.

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads within ML, Finance, Marketing, and Analytics domains to translate operational use cases into clear, robust technical requirements to improve our product.

  • Automate observability metrics, monitoring, and data integrity tests to ensure reliable, trusted data sources and strong data governance across central warehouse and external team product workflows.

  • Drive data engineering best practices, conduct technical design reviews, and mentor engineers across the broader data team.

What We're Looking For

  • Data Engineering: Deep proficiency in Python and SQL, advanced understanding of modern data warehouse internals (AWS Redshift), efficient ways of working on S3, and strong data engineering fundamentals including scalability, reliability, fault tolerance, and trade-off analysis.

  • Production pipelines: Extensive experience designing, building, and operating data processing solutions (Airflow, AppFlow, Metaflow, dbt, dlt), and working with distributed systems in production (Spark on EMR, Glue).

  • DataOps: Strong software engineering and systems engineering skills, with a proven record of managing platform-level systems end-to-end. Experience applying DataOps, GitOps, Terraform, CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Docker), and observability tools. Familiarity with MLOps principles, cloud-native infrastructure, and container orchestration.

  • Technical Leadership: Proven ability to take some technical ownership of complex projects in autonomy, drive architectural decisions, and mentor team members in technical best practices.

  • Nice to have: Streaming experience (Kinesis, Firehose, Flink), Kubernetes and Helm experience.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work at a scaling social impact company and directly reduce food waste globally.

  • Work-life balance focus (no mandatory overtime or standard on-call duty).

  • Hybrid work setup in our Copenhagen HQ (4 days in office).

  • To be part of an international company, with over 1,300+ colleagues across 19 countries that are on the same important mission.

  • An informal environment, working alongside 180+ passionate people within Tech & Product

  • We celebrate our differences and our successes and have a strong values-driven team culture.

Our values

We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We believe in a #oneteam.

We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers and elevate one another.

We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.

We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving.

We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.

How To Apply

We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above.

Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.

Please submit your CV/resume in English.

Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

jobs.title: セールススペシャリスト/Sales Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
【主な役割】

日本でのマーケット拡大を牽引するフロントランナーとして、最初のアプローチから契約締結、さらには店舗の初期導入サポートまでを一気通貫で担当します。飲食店や小売店などの潜在的なパートナーへ能動的にアプローチし、Too Good To Goがどのように彼らのビジネスをサポートできるかを提案します。

  • 新規開拓営業： 個店から複数店舗を展開するチェーン店を経営する飲食店、カフェ、ベーカリー、コンビニなどへ、電話・メール・対面訪問を通じてアプローチ。

  • ソリューション提案：

    • 廃棄コストの削減や新規顧客獲得など、店舗側の課題に合わせた導入メリットを提案。

    • オンラインでの商談がメインですが、実際に訪問するケースも有り。

  • パイプライン管理： Salesforceを活用して、自身の営業活動を管理し、優先順位をつけながら効率的にクロージングまで実施。

  • 導入・初期グロース支援：

    • オンボーディング： パートナー店舗がスムーズに利用開始できるよう、プラットフォームへの登録、アプリの操作方法、出品スケジュールの設定などをレクチャー。

    • チーム連携： 加盟店との契約締結後、オンボーディングおよび販売開始までをサポートし、その後はグロースチームへスムーズに引き継ぎ。店舗が利用開始初日から成果を出せるよう、連携して伴走します。

  • ナレッジ共有： 立ち上げ期ならではの気づきをチームに共有し、日本独自のベストプラクティスを構築。

 

【応募要件】

（必須スキル・経験）

  • 営業経験： インサイドセールス、新規開拓、ソリューション営業など（商材不問）。

    または、

    営業未経験・第二新卒の方も、ミッションへの強い共感があれば歓迎します。

  • マインドセット： 目標達成への強いコミットメントがあり、アウトバウンド営業に抵抗がない方。

  • 日本語力： 母国語（ネイティブ）レベル。

（歓迎スキル・経験）

  • Salesforceやその他CRMの使用経験。

  • 飲食店への営業経験がある方

  • 英語力（グローバルチームとの知見共有に活かせます ※必須ではありません）。

（求める人物像）

  • 能動的な成長意欲： フィードバックを素直に受け入れ、失敗も次の学びへと変えられる方

  • 自律性と自己管理力： 立ち上げフェーズの不確実性を楽しみ、自ら計画を立てて能動的に動ける方

  • 高いコミュニケーション力： 相手のニーズを鋭く察知し、クリエイティブに疑問や懸念を解消できる方

  • 「NO」を楽しめるスタンス： 「お断り」を本音を引き出すチャンスと捉え、粘り強く提案を楽しめる方

  • 困難を楽しめるしなやかさ： 課題に直面したときこそ「どう突破するか」をワクワクして考えられる方

  • バランス感覚： 高い自己モチベーションを持ち、個人の成果だけでなくチームの成果に向けても仲間と協力できる方

【会社概要】

Too Good To Go は、余った食品に価値を見出し、食品廃棄物のない地球を目指す、デンマーク発のソーシャルグッドカンパニーです。欧州、北米、アジア太平洋地域など20カ国で、1億2,000 万を超える登録ユーザーと20万以上の加盟パートナー企業とともに世界最大のフードロスマーケットプレイスを展開。これまで累計6億食以上のフードロス削減に貢献しました。グローサリーストア、ベーカリーカフェ、カジュアルレストラン、ファストフード、食品メーカーや卸業者など、幅広い業態と提携しており、Carrefour、ALDI、ユニリーバ、スターバックス、Whole Foods Market、SPAR、PAUL Group などが参加しています。日本国内においては、正式ローンチから約3ヶ月半で登録ユーザー数50万人を突破し、展開国20カ国の中でも最速の成長を記録しています。

 

【ビジョン・ミッション】

Too Good To Goは、「フードロスのない社会を目指す（WE DREAM OF A PLANET WITH NO FOOD WASTE）」ことをビジョンとして掲げています。この実現に向け、「フードロス削減に共に立ち向かうすべての人々を支え、力を与える（INSPIRE AND EMPOWER EVERYONE TO FIGHT FOOD WASTE TOGETHER）」ことをミッションに、アプリの提供にとどまらず、消費者、店舗、そして社会全体を巻き込み、誰もが日常の中で簡単にフードロス削減というアクションに参加できる仕組みを作ることで、一人ひとりの小さな選択が大きな変化を生む未来を目指して活動しています。

 

【私たちの理念】

  • 未来に残す-WE BUILD A LEGACY-
    私たちは、食を愛し、変化を仕掛けるイノベーター。“Food Lovers”としての心を忘れず、仲間とともに挑戦し、より良い地球の未来につなげていきます。

  • 基準を超える-WE RAISE THE BAR-
    「これでいい」ではなく、「もっと良くできる」を探し続けます。一歩踏み出す行動力と、学び続ける柔軟さを大切にしながら、変化を味方に、成長を楽しむチームであり続けます。

  • 一緒に勝つ-WE WIN TOGETHER-
    一人では出せない力を、重ねてつくるのが私たちのチームワーク。一人ひとりが責任を持ち、互いに支え合いながら、共通のゴールに向かって、成果を積み重ねていきます。

  • シンプルが一番-WE KEEP IT SIMPLE-
    複雑なことにも丁寧に向き合い、本質をわかりやすく伝えます。思いやりを感じつつも率直なフィードバックで互いの成長を促し、誠実さと信頼を育んでいきます。

  • 思いやりを持つ-WE CARE-
    人を思いやる気持ちを、すべての関係の中心に。仲間、パートナー、お客さま、それぞれに敬意を持って向き合い、つながりを楽しみ、大切にしながらその輪を大きくしていきます。

 

【Too Good To Goで働く魅力】

  • 目に見える社会的インパクト（フードロス削減への貢献）：「フードロスの削減」という地球規模の課題に挑むソーシャルインパクト企業です。日々の業務が環境保護や持続可能な社会づくりに直接つながる手応えを実感できます。

  • 世界中の仲間とつながるグローバルチーム： 20カ国・1,350名以上の多様なメンバーと共に働きます。国や文化を超えてベストプラクティスを共有し、互いに支え合いながら成長できる刺激的な環境です。

  • 日本立ち上げ（スケールアップ）をリードする成長機会：組織も事業オペレーションもまさに構築中のフェーズです。グローバルな事業基盤を活用しながら、日本市場での立ち上げを自らの手で形にしていく貴重なキャリア経験が得られます。

  • 「We Care」が根付く、自分らしさを発揮できるオープンな風土：仲間への思いやりと敬意を大切にする「We Care」の精神が組織全体に浸透しています。役職や国籍に関係なく誰もが自分らしく意見を発信し、新しい挑戦を互いに支え合える環境です。

  • チームの成功を分かち合う文化：「We Win Together」のバリューのもと、日々の小さな前進や成果もチーム全体でリスペクトし、その成功を全員で分かち合います。

 

【その他】

  • 雇用形態：正社員

  • 給与：応相談

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious mission: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

More than 1/3 of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet. 10% of greenhouse gas emissions come from food waste and loss.

Through our marketplace app, we connect businesses that have unsold, surplus food, with consumers who can buy and enjoy it at a significantly reduced price. We have a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste.

Alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re looking for talented people with diverse skills and backgrounds to add to our rapidly growing team. That is where you come in: we are growing our superstar Sales team in Poland and we’re looking for exceptional Sales Specialists to join Too Good To Go in Warsaw.

This position requires you to be based in Warsaw and go to the office 3 days per week.

Your mission:

You're eager to build connections and grow our community by signing up cafes, restaurants, convenience stores, bakeries, and any other independent food retailers.

What we need:

  • This is a mix of inside and outside sales. You will have several ad-hoc meetings per week and several cold calls per day; you will often seal the partnership with face to face meetings

  • You will own the whole sales process, and sign the partners on the platform

  • Communicate (through physical visits, email, cold-calls, social media) with restaurants and other food businesses to introduce Too Good To Go

  • Research accounts, identify stakeholders/decision-makers and generate interest about Too Good To Go and sign partnerships with them

  • Find creative ways of reaching potential business partners

  • Seeking ambassadors among the Too Good To Go partners community that will join us in sharing our mission widely

What you should bring:

We are looking for people who want to build a career in sales in a supportive and high growth social impact business. This could be your first sales role, or you may have some experience already in a sales or business development role. We’re looking for:

  • Experience where you have pitched and closed opportunities over the phone and/or in person is beneficial, especially if you have done cold-calling and face to face meetings on an ad-hoc basis

  • First class communication skills - from listening to presenting ideas and persuading

  • Resilience and motivation to achieve results through perseverance and high call and meeting volumes

  • First experience working with KPIs, such as number of cold calls, number of acquired partners, or GMV-driven targets

  • A genuine motivation to contribute to our mission

  • High energy and self-motivation

  • Strong organisational and time management skills

  • Fluency in Polish (C2) and B2 level of English

  • A drive to achieve strong individual results while also helping your team succeed

  • Experience managing your own sales pipeline and prioritising prospects based on insights is also beneficial

Our Values:

  • We Win Together

  • We Raise the Bar

  • We Keep It Simple

  • We Build A Legacy

  • We Care

What we offer :

WORK FLEXIBLY:

• Enjoy hybrid working from our great offices, at home or abroad

• Private medical care - Allianz medical package

• Additional days off for significant life events

CELEBRATE & SOCIALISE

• Regular social events like summer and winter parties

• Coffee, snacks and fully-equipped kitchens

• Get to know our community with free Surprise Bag vouchers

• Paid volunteer time through our Shareback volunteering programme

• Diversity, Equity & Inclusive groups

LOCAL BENEFITS:

  • A competitive salary with opportunity for performance-related bonuses

  • Additional paid time off (5 days extra per year after 6 months at TGTG) beyond local legislation

  • Health insurance

  • Pension plan (PPK)

  • Refund on glasses / contact lenses

  • myBenefit: cafeteria & multisport card

  • Access to Hedepy platform (wellbeing platform)

How to apply:

Na tym stanowisku wymagamy doskonałej znajomości jęz. polskiego oraz jęz. angielskiego. Jeśli jesteś zainteresowana/-y, aby do nas dołączyć - nie zwlekaj! Aplikuj! Czekamy, aby móc Cię poznać!

We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.

  • Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

We are on a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste: alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re looking for talented people with diverse skills and backgrounds to add to our rapidly growing team. That is where you come in: we’re looking for an exceptional Head of Key Accounts based in London.

The Mission:

As Head of Key Accounts, you will play a pivotal role in the growth of Too Good To Go in the UK & IE by strategically leading and driving the success of the Key Accounts function. You will be directly responsible for managing the Key Account team of 15+ FTEs as they drive their teams in the acquisition and growth of partnerships across all verticals, mainly; Food Retail, Restaurants and Franchise.

You are part of the management team and report directly to our Country Director. You will have the overall responsibility of defining strategy, setting priorities, building and maintaining a high-performing team, creating cross-functional collaboration, and achieving the KA team’s targets. In addition, you will be part of an international community of Key Account leaders and engage actively with our colleagues in Marketing, Product and Business Operations.

Responsibilities Include:

Strategic Leadership & Vision: Provide inspiring leadership to the Key Account team. Shape and execute the long-term commercial strategy for Key Accounts across the UK & IE, directly aligning growth and revenue targets with Too Good To Go’s mission to end food waste.

Team Development: Build, coach, and empower a high-performing Key Account team using advanced sales and negotiation methodologies.

Strategic Impact: Serve as an active member of the UK leadership team, contributing to broader company growth and cross-functional strategy.

Partnership Growth: Identify, establish, and expand high-value strategic partnerships across key verticals.

Acquisition & Rollout: Lead overall account acquisition strategy, governing end-to-end rollouts and onboarding for new Key Accounts.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Business Operations to align strategies, share market insights, and develop tailored value propositions for key accounts.

Financial & Operational Ownership: Drive P&L ownership for the Key Account function, managing targets, budgeting, operational performance, and forecasting.

Who We Are Looking For:

Commercial Acumen & Experience: Extensive experience within senior Key Account Management and Business Development, demonstrating exceptional commercial acumen and a proven track record of driving revenue growth.

Industry Expertise: Proven experience in food retail, food delivery, or retail tech, backed by a strong network and in-depth understanding of national commercial accounts (e.g., restaurants & retail)

Leadership & People Development: Demonstrated success leading, building, and scaling high-performing teams, ideally within a fast-paced scale-up or high-growth business environment.

Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to craft compelling narratives and present effectively to any audience, including C-suite.

Negotiation & Coaching Mastery: Advanced negotiation expertise with a proven background in training, coaching, and empowering employees to structure complex deals and deliver high-impact pitches.

Forecasting & Strategic Planning: Strong capabilities in commercial planning, forecasting, and partner lifecycle management. Experience using the MEDDIC methodology is a strong plus.

Data-Driven Decision Making: A highly analytical mindset with the ability to interpret and leverage complex data sets and analytics tools (such as Salesforce and Looker) to identify strategic opportunities for growth.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Proven ability to partner closely with departments like Marketing, Product, and Business Operations to co-create unique value propositions and scale operations.

Resilience & Execution: A proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and brings high energy to execution.

Mission Alignment: Deeply passionate about our mission to end food waste and driven to make a positive, lasting influence.

What we offer you

WORK FLEXIBLY:

25 days of statutory vacation leave plus 5 extra days after 6 months of employment

  • Additional day off for significant life events

  • 3 extra Milestone leave days after 3 years of employment

  • Enjoy hybrid working from our great offices, at home (max 3 days per week) or abroad

  • Extra parental leave beyond local legislation

  • The option to take an extra week of unpaid leave

CELEBRATE & SOCIALISE

  • Regular social events like summer, Christmas & Halloween parties

  • Coffee, snacks and fully-equipped kitchens

At Too Good To Go, you’ll join a team that cares about developing strategic partnerships, making value-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to the world’s food waste crisis. You’ll join an elite team to elevate our growth and collaborate daily with world-class minds—while doing work that’s both high-impact and deeply meaningful.

The Role

As the Marketing Manager for North America, you will own the local strategy and execution of consumer-facing campaigns across the US and Canada. Sitting within the B2C Marketing Team, you will be the creative force that brings the Too Good To Go brand to life, inspiring both prospective and existing customers to join the food waste movement.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between imaginative storytelling and analytical rigor. You will own your workstreams end-to-end, moving fluidly from high-level campaign concepting to tactical execution. Rather than settling for vanity metrics, you will look deep into the data to prioritize initiatives that drive true brand love, user acquisition, and measurable marketplace impact.

Core Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy & Brand Concepting (B2C)

  • Campaign Ownership: Own the strategy, ideation, and end-to-end execution of high-impact, consumer-facing marketing campaigns that drive brand awareness and user adoption across North America.

  • Brand Collaborations: Identify, pitch, and execute strategic partnerships and brand collaborations that amplify our mission and connect Too Good To Go with culturally relevant audiences.

  • Creative Oversight: Partner closely with external creative agencies and internal design teams to oversee production, ensuring all marketing assets and copy are exceptionally creative, on-brand, and localized for the North American market.

Content, Influencer & Community Growth

  • Influencer Marketing: Scale and manage our influencer marketing program from end-to-end, including sourcing creators, negotiating contracts, briefing content, and tracking ROI.

  • Owned Social & Content Creation: Drive the overarching strategy for our owned social media channels, concepting highly engaging, viral-worthy content that highlights the value of saving food.

  • Community Management: Oversee regional community management strategies to foster deep brand loyalty, turn casual users into brand advocates, and keep our audience highly engaged.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Data Impact

  • Matrixed Collaboration: Serve as a key connective tissue across marketing verticals, collaborating daily with local and global teams—including CRM Marketing Managers, Partner Marketing Managers, Social Media Managers, and PR Managers.

  • Data-Driven Optimization: Regularly dig into performance data to evaluate campaign health. Move beyond likes and impressions to measure how your workstreams impact core business metrics like customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.

Requirements

  • The Experience: Significant years of hands-on experience in Brand Marketing, Campaign Management, or Consumer Marketing. Experience within a high-growth B2C app or mobile-first marketplace is highly preferred.

  • Creative Brand Acumen: A natural creative storyteller who instinctively understands how to bring a brand identity to life across digital and physical touchpoints. Proven experience managing external creative agencies is a must.

  • Multi-Channel Expertise: Deep familiarity with modern consumer marketing channels, including influencer networks, owned social platforms (TikTok, Instagram), experiential activations, and community management.

  • Data Fluency: You don't just report on vanity metrics; you are comfortable digging into the data to understand the true business impact of your campaigns and use insights to build your next strategy.

  • Strategic & Tactical: You can dream up big, innovative campaign ideas but are equally excited to roll up your sleeves, build briefs, write copy, and execute the work.

  • Collaborative Owner: You are a self-starter who thrives when given total ownership of a project, while remaining a supportive, highly aligned team player within a complex global structure.

What it takes to succeed

We are looking for people who are energized by the opportunity and driven by the discipline it takes to achieve it. Too Good To Go is building a high performing team where the right people thrive by holding themselves and each other to these standards. If you are looking for a place to grow, own your work, and make an impact—you’ll fit right in.

To succeed here, you’ll need to embody these four principles:

  • Choose Excellence over Ease: You take initiative and prioritize long-term impact over short-term comfort, consistently pushing for exceptional quality rather than settling for "good enough."

  • Demonstrate Integrity and Responsibility: You do the right thing when no one is watching. You recognize your own agency to influence outcomes and take responsibility —meeting setbacks with solutions and humility rather than excuses.

  • Seek Honesty: You ask questions and prioritize truth over comfort, welcoming candid feedback, and addressing performance directly to ensure we never stop improving.

  • Bring Energy and Joy to the Journey: You take responsibility for the energy you bring to the team, finding meaning in the work while celebrating our shared wins and lessons.

Benefits

Agility & Autonomy

  • Modern Hybrid Model: Maintain a high-performance rhythm with a balance of focused remote work and collaborative office days (3x a week) in our NYC hub.

  • Global Mobility: The flexibility to work from abroad for up to 30 days per year.

  • Dedicated Time to Recharge: 20 days of paid vacation plus additional paid volunteer time through our Shareback program.

  • Parental Support: Comprehensive paid parental leave with top-up support to ensure you can be present for life’s most significant milestones.

Holistic Wellbeing & Security

  • Premium Health Coverage: 100% employer-paid medical (EPO), dental, and vision options for employees.

  • Comprehensive Support: Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health care, legal and financial advisory, and family support.

  • Active Lifestyle: Stay energized with monthly ClassPass credits and our dedicated bike mobility program.

  • Financial Future: Plan for long-term security with a 401(k) program, including an employer-matched contribution.

Community & Belonging

  • Global Connectivity: Engage with our international team through various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), including P.R.I.D.E., Women in the Workplace, Global Majority Voices, and Functionally Diverse groups.

  • Vibrant Workspace: Experience a welcoming office environment with curated snacks, premium coffee, and regular team celebrations that foster a true sense of community.

How to apply

  • We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.

  • Submit your CV and Cover letter in English.

  • Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

Certain US states/jurisdictions require Too Good To Go to include a reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role. A reasonable estimate of the range for new joiners for this role in the United States is $85,000 - $95,000. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, an individual's assigned work location, experience, and expertise.

We’re looking for a Workforce Experience Coordinator to join the team at Too Good To Go in Paris!

Your Mission

The Workplace Experience Coordinator plays a central role in cultivating a welcoming, functional, and inspiring environment for the entire Too Good To Go team.
This position is responsible for the seamless day-to-day operations of our office, ensuring that it is a space that supports our work, reflects our values, and brings people together with a focus on ensuring the best possible working conditions for the teams. You'll be at the heart of making our offices places people genuinely want to come to. 

As the central point of contact for all office-related matters, this role will ensure our workspace runs as smoothly as possible. The ideal candidate is part operations manager, part event planner, and a people person, with a keen eye for detail and a passion for creating a positive atmosphere.

N.B. Due to the nature of the role, this role is expected to be in the office 4 days per week (Mondays-Thursdays). 80% or 100% contribution.

Responsibilities

  • Office & Reception Management: Take full ownership of the Too Good To Go office and reception area. This includes serving as the first point of contact for all visitors and guests, managing incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries, and ensuring the office and meeting rooms are always neat, inviting, and fully prepared for daily use.

  • Operations & Budgeting: Manage daily office life by overseeing a range of administrative and financial tasks. You'll be responsible for ordering office supplies, managing weekly grocery orders, and handling all related expenses, budgets, and invoice approvals.
    You will provide input to CD in the forecasting process for costs such as IT and office space.
    You will be the point of contact to process incoming office invoices for payment, ensure proper coding and sending them for approval.

  • Employee Support & Onboarding: Act as a daily resource for the team and the face of P&C in the local office.
    This will include coordinating lunch orders and managing parts of the employee on and off-boarding process in collaboration with the Global P&C team, which could include gathering documents for payroll, or setting up laptops. 

  • Gifts & Merch: You will be responsible for managing company merchandise for new joiners, including budget management and orders.
    You will also be responsible for any additional gifts run in market.

  • Hardware & Phone management: You will be responsible for procuring, distributing and managing the inventory of all IT equipment and mobile phones.
    In addition, you will handle phone subscriptions for staff if required.
    In addition, you will be responsible for any other physical requirements of employees for the office such as access cards and keys, car leasings, hotel bookings etc.

  • Event Planning & Engagement: Plan and execute a variety of company events and celebrations, from weekly meetings every Monday, quarterly meetings or summits, Shareback volunteering to larger gatherings like summer and end of year parties. This also includes organizing staff gifts to celebrate key milestones and achievements, supporting TGTG visitors to the office, and organising local and global Townhall viewings. You will also work closely with the DEI Taskforce in your market to organise any local DEI activities, and drive social activities in your market.
    You’ll be the logistical support for all internal events organized by various departments and will utilize your creativity and service mindset to contribute to a vibrant workplace community.

  • Facilities & Vendor Relations: Serve as the primary contact for all office-related agreements and services. You will liaise with the landlord, maintenance, and various service providers to ensure the office facilities are well-maintained and to manage access for all staff.
    You will manage contracts and relationships with some suppliers.

  • Sustainability & Process Improvement: Actively search for and implement ways to make our office more sustainable, and contribute relevant data to our global carbon reporting requirements. 

  • Workplace safety requirements: You will be responsible for meeting all safety and compliance requirements in the office, including coordinating training and equipment for all workplace and occupational safety requirements such as first raiders, fire safety marshalls or similar.

  • Overall office management: You will manage the ongoing office contract, and work closely with the CD and global procurement for office contract renewals or any potential office moves. You will contribute to updating office guidelines for our Employee Handbook.

  • Ad-hoc projects: Additionally, you will identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and take the lead on a variety of ad-hoc projects to enhance the overall workplace experience.

What We're Looking For

  • Operational Excellence: Proven experience in an office management, facilities, or similar administrative role, with a strong focus on maintaining a highly organized and efficient workspace.

  • Logistics & Planning: Exceptional project and event management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining a keen attention to detail.

  • Budgeting & Finance: Experience managing budgets, tracking expenses, and handling invoices with accuracy.
    Tools used: Gmail & google workspace, AI tools. 

  • Proactive & Resourceful: A natural problem-solver who can anticipate needs and find creative solutions with a can-do attitude.

  • Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities, with a friendly and professional demeanor. You thrive on helping others and are the go-to person for all office-related queries.
    Fluent in English. 

  • Sustainability Focus: A passion for sustainability and a desire to contribute to our mission through practical, daily actions within the office.

Our values

  • We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We believe in a #oneteam.

  • We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers and elevate one another.

  • We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.

  • We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving. 

  • We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.

What we have to offer 

  • WORK FLEXIBLY: 

    • An extra one-month for  parental leave and days off beyond local legislation 

    • Health insurance and pension plans

    • Additional days off for significant life events

  • CELEBRATE & SOCIALISE

    • Regular social events like summer and winter parties

    • Coffee, snacks and fully-equipped kitchens

    • Get to know our community with a monthly free Surprise Bag

    • Paid volunteer time through our Shareback volunteering programme

    • Women in the Workplace, P.R.I.D.E., People of Colour and Functionally Diverse Employee Resource Groups

  • LOCAL BENEFITS

    • Meal vouchers, partially covered by Too Good To Go 

    • Annual mobility budget

    • Private fitness room and free access to Morning Coworking classes

How to apply

  • We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.

  • Submit your CV and Cover letter in French or English.

  • Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

jobs.title: CRM Manager (Braze Preferred)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our mission at Too Good To Go is to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Too Good To Go, you’ll join a team that cares about developing strategic partnerships, making value-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to the world’s food waste crisis. You’ll join an elite team to elevate our growth and collaborate daily with world-class minds—while doing work that’s both high-impact and deeply meaningful.

The Role

As the CRM Manager for North America, you will own the local strategy and end-to-end execution across the US and Canada. Serving as a bridge between local impact and global excellence, you will partner closely with the Global CRM team to optimize our tech stack (Braze, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) and refine processes, ensuring global tools are leveraged to maximize effectiveness for North American consumers.

In this role, you will set the communication strategy for our existing users—with a focus on increasing lifetime value, retention, and loyalty—while supporting B2B lead generation efforts to bring qualified partners onto the platform.

Core Responsibilities

North American Strategy & Execution (B2C)

  • Local Roadmap: Own the North American CRM campaign and content calendar from end-to-end; design, build, and deploy multi-channel campaigns (Email, Push, In-App) that capitalize on local trends and seasonal moments.

  • Growth & Optimization: Identify opportunities to drive user acquisition and marketplace density. Run continuous A/B tests on segmentation, content, and timing to improve core metrics (Conversion, CTR, and Churn).

  • Data & Segmentation: Utilize internal tools (Looker, Amplitude and Braze) to build sophisticated audience segments based on behavior, geography, and user preferences.

Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration (B2B)

  • B2B Lead Nurturing: Collaborate with B2B Marketing / Sales to build automated communication funnels that move prospective partners (restaurants, retailers) from prospective leads to qualified leads to close.

  • Supply Engagement: Support the supply side of the marketplace by communicating value to existing partners, helping them maximize their impact on the platform.

Global Partnership & Systems

  • Lifecycle Management: Partner with global to improve opportunities within lifecycle and localization —from onboarding and early adoption to retention and reactivation—optimizing global templates to resonate with North American consumers.

  • Tool & Process Optimization: Partner with Global CRM and Tech teams to maximize the effectiveness of technical stack and capabilities.

  • Feedback Loop: Provide local insights and technical requirements to help the global team develop scalable automation tools and templates that work for regional markets.

  • Innovation: Act as the lead for North American experimentation, piloting new CRM features or personalization tactics before global rollout.

Requirements

  • The Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in CRM, Lifecycle, or Retention Marketing. You have a proven track record in a mobile-first marketplace or high-growth B2C app environment.

  • Braze Mastery: You are a power user of Braze (or similar platforms like Iterable/Salesforce Marketing Cloud). You are comfortable with managing multi-channel orchestration across email, push, in-app.

  • Data Fluency: You don’t just report on open rates; you track how CRM impacts CAC, LTV, and frequency. You lean into A/B testing to influence strategy.

  • Strategic & Tactical: You can think high-level about user journeys but are equally happy to "get your hands dirty" building campaigns and QAing links.

  • Collaborative & Adaptable: You know how to advocate for local needs while remaining a team player within a global structure.

What it takes to succeed

We are looking for people who are energized by the opportunity and driven by the discipline it takes to achieve it. Too Good To Go is building a high performing team where the right people thrive by holding themselves and each other to these standards. If you are looking for a place to grow, own your work, and make an impact—you’ll fit right in.

To succeed here, you’ll need to embody these four principles:

  • Choose Excellence over Ease: You take initiative and prioritize long-term impact over short-term comfort, consistently pushing for exceptional quality rather than settling for "good enough."

  • Demonstrate Integrity and Responsibility: You do the right thing when no one is watching. You recognize your own agency to influence outcomes and take responsibility —meeting setbacks with solutions and humility rather than excuses.

  • Seek Honesty: You ask questions and prioritize truth over comfort, welcoming candid feedback, and addressing performance directly to ensure we never stop improving.

  • Bring Energy and Joy to the Journey: You take responsibility for the energy you bring to the team, finding meaning in the work while celebrating our shared wins and lessons.

Benefits

Agility & Autonomy

  • Modern Hybrid Model: Maintain a high-performance rhythm with a balance of focused remote work and collaborative office days (3x a week) in our New York hub.

  • Global Mobility: The flexibility to work from abroad for up to 30 days per year.

  • Dedicated Time to Recharge: 20 days of paid vacation plus additional paid volunteer time through our Shareback program.

  • Parental Support: Comprehensive paid parental leave with top-up support to ensure you can be present for life’s most significant milestones.

Holistic Wellbeing & Security

  • Premium Health Coverage: 100% employer-paid medical (EPO), dental, and vision options for employees.

  • Comprehensive Support: Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health care, legal and financial advisory, and family support.

  • Active Lifestyle: Stay energized with monthly ClassPass credits and our dedicated bike mobility program.

  • Financial Future: Plan for long-term security with a 401(k) program, including an employer-matched contribution.

Community & Belonging

  • Global Connectivity: Engage with our international team through various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), including P.R.I.D.E., Women in the Workplace, Global Majority Voices, and Functionally Diverse groups.

  • Vibrant Workspace: Experience a welcoming office environment with curated snacks, premium coffee, and regular team celebrations that foster a true sense of community.

How to apply

  • We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.

  • Submit your CV and Cover letter in English.

  • Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

Certain US states/jurisdictions require Too Good To Go to include a reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role. A reasonable estimate of the range for new joiners for this role in the United States is $85,000 - $103,000. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, an individual's assigned work location, experience, and expertise.

Si vous aimez signer de nouveaux contrats et piloter l'intégralité du cycle de vente — de l'identification du prospect au closing —, ce rôle pourrait être fait pour vous.

Votre quotidien : Créer le contact avec de futurs partenaires, principalement par téléphone (environ 50 à 60 appels par jour), mais aussi par e-mail, LinkedIn ou SMS... tous les moyens sont bons pour ouvrir des portes ! Votre mission ? Convaincre les commerçants de quartier et les enseignes de rejoindre la communauté Too Good To Go pour lutter, ensemble, contre le gaspillage alimentaire.

Chez nous, la formation, les outils et l'accompagnement vous sont fournis dès votre arrivée. Ce qui fera la différence ? Votre énergie, votre curiosité, votre résilience et votre humilité, bien plus que votre nombre d'années d'expérience. Venez avec le bon état d'esprit, nous vous aiderons à développer les compétences !

À propos du poste

Vous serez le maître de votre propre succès en gérant votre pipeline et votre activité hebdomadaire. Nous posons les bases, mais votre ambition, votre réactivité et votre dynamisme détermineront vos résultats. Pour ce faire, vous devrez :

  • Chasse et Closing : Vous êtes le premier point de contact des commerçants. Vous gérez l'intégralité du tunnel de vente (de la prospection jusqu’au closing).

  • Gestion des opportunités : À partir d'un fichier de prospection qualifié, vous priorisez vos actions et guidez vos prospects jusqu'à la signature.

  • Suivi et Transition : Vous alimentez et pilotez sainement votre pipeline de ventes. Vous assurez un passage de relais fluide aux équipes Growth pour garantir le succès de vos partenaires dès leur premier jour sur l'application.

Vos missions clés

  • Gérer les opportunités auprès des PME, y compris les petits commerces de quartier et les chaînes de magasins, ce qui implique souvent de dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs multiples.

  • Contacter les partenaires potentiels pour comprendre leurs besoins et leur démontrer la valeur ajoutée que nous pouvons leur apporter.

  • Apprendre et appliquer notre méthodologie de vente SNAP pour interagir efficacement avec une grande variété d'entreprises.

  • Guider les partenaires tout au long de leur inscription et de leur intégration sur notre plateforme.

  • Piloter votre pipeline en utilisant Salesforce pour suivre et faire progresser vos opportunités.

  • Collaborer avec l'équipe Growth pour garantir un passage de relais et une expérience d'intégration fluide dès le premier jour du partenaire sur la plateforme.

  • Prendre des mesures concrètes pour votre propre développement, avec un engagement fort envers l'amélioration continue.

Votre profil

Peu importe que vous veniez de la vente, du support client, de l'hôtellerie-restauration ou d'un tout autre secteur : chez Too Good To Go, c'est l'état d'esprit qui prime !

  • Vous aimez les défis et vous savez rebondir : pour vous, un « non » est juste une opportunité de trouver une approche plus créative.

  • Vous êtes d'un naturel curieux, persévérant et vous cherchez constamment à progresser et à sortir de votre zone de confort.

  • Vous êtes à l'écoute, fin négociateur et vous savez identifier les besoins de vos interlocuteurs pour y répondre avec impact.

  • Vous appréciez les feedbacks constructifs et vous les utilisez pour vous améliorer au quotidien.

  • Et surtout : vous êtes passionné(e) par la vente !

SUMMIT

Nos Valeurs

  • We Win Together

  • We Raise the Bar

  • We Keep It Simple

  • We Build A Legacy

  • We Care

Avantages :

  • Une opportunité rare de travailler dans une entreprise à impact social où tu peux te réveiller chaque jour en sachant que tu apportes un changement positif.

  • L'expérience de faire partie d'une entreprise internationale avec +1300 Waste Warriors enthousiastes et talentueux dans 20 pays - toujours prêts à partager leurs connaissances et leur soutien !

  • Un fort développement personnel et professionnel dans un environnement intense et à forte croissance.

  • Une culture d'entreprise ouverte où tu disposeras de l'indépendance et de l'espace nécessaire pour laisser libre cours à ta créativité.

  • Une culture d'équipe forte où les succès sont célébrés ensemble.

  • Politique de télétravail : 3 jours par semaine + 1 semaine autorisée par trimestre

  • La possibilité de consacrer jusqu'à 4 jours travaillés à des associations caritatives (Restos de cœur, Banques Alimentaires...)

Processus de recrutement :

  • Étape 1, entretien de 30mn avec une personne de l'équipe Talent Acquisition

  • Étape 2, entretien d'une heure avec un Team Leader

  • Étape 3. entretien de 30mn avec notre Head of Sales

💡 Le saviez-vous ? Plus de 40 % de la nourriture produite dans le monde est gaspillée, ce qui représente environ 10 % des émissions mondiales de gaz à effet de serre (soit près de 5 fois plus que l'ensemble du secteur aérien !).

Aujourd'hui, Too Good To Go, c'est plus de 133 millions d'utilisateurs et 261 000 partenaires actifs dans 20 pays. Ensemble, nous avons déjà sauvé plus de 517 millions de repas de la poubelle. Prêt(e) à nous rejoindre

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Lisbon
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste. Why do we need to do that? Because more than 1/3 of the food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, 10% of greenhouse gas emissions come from food waste!

As the world’s largest food waste-fighting app, we connect stores that have unsold, surplus food with consumers who buy and enjoy it. We're on a mission to inspire and empower everyone to take action against food waste, so we’re doing all we can to create educational tools, make our knowledge as accessible as possible, find new business solutions and even change legislation to reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast, with our community of over 120 million users in 20 countries, saving more than 600+ million meals from going to waste! But there’s still a lot more we want to achieve.

We’re looking for an exceptional Business Development Manager (Acquisition) to join our Portuguese Key Accounts team at Too Good To Go in Lisbon.

Your role

Your primary responsibility will be to identify, develop and acquire new strategic Key Accounts from scratch, helping drive the growth of the Portuguese marketplace and expand Too Good To Go into new categories.

A key priority will be accelerating our growth in the Non-Food market, particularly across Beauty & Cosmetics, Personal Care, Nutrition, Pet Care and Home Care. You will also develop selected opportunities within the Food sector, including QSR, Hotels, Gas Stations and other strategic retail and food service segments.

Reporting to the Head of Key Accounts, you will own opportunities from initial market mapping and prospecting through negotiation, pilot and rollout. You will work closely with the Key Account Retention team to ensure successful onboarding, scalable rollouts and strong long-term partnerships.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full sales cycle: Take full ownership of strategic acquisition opportunities, from lead generation and first contact through negotiation, pilot and rollout. You will manage your own pipeline and be accountable for achieving ambitious commercial targets.

  • Market Mapping & Prospecting: Identify high-potential industries, segments and companies, with a particular focus on Non-Food. Build a strong acquisition pipeline and map complex organisations to identify decision-makers, Economic Buyers and other key stakeholders.

  • Open doors: Proactively approach large national and international companies, create new relationships and secure meetings with senior stakeholders.

  • Pitch & Negotiate: Understand each prospect's business challenges and build a compelling value proposition. Create and deliver high-quality presentations and business cases, and confidently negotiate commercial conditions with senior decision-makers.

  • Build strategic partnerships: Go beyond selling the Too Good To Go solution. Understand how we can create value for partners through surplus monetisation, customer acquisition, footfall, additional sales and sustainability impact.

  • Develop proposals: Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, Legal and Cluster/Global Commercial teams to develop strong commercial proposals and solutions adapted to each partner.

  • Launch & Scale: Design pilots with clear success criteria, analyse results and build the business case for wider rollout. Together with the Retention team, identify corrective actions when needed and ensure a smooth transition from acquisition to long-term account management.

  • Manage pipeline & forecast: Maintain a high-quality and accurate pipeline in Salesforce, with clear next steps, realistic timelines and strong forecasting discipline.

Strategy & Commercial Excellence

  • Identify new markets, categories and business models that can accelerate Too Good To Go's growth in Portugal.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the Non-Food landscape, particularly Beauty & Cosmetics, Personal Care, Nutrition, Pet Care and Home Care.

  • Bring market insights and commercial opportunities to the Portuguese Key Accounts strategy.

  • Develop and share best practices with Portuguese, South Cluster and Global commercial teams.

  • Work closely with the Head of Key Accounts to define acquisition priorities and commercial strategy.

  • Continuously improve acquisition and rollout processes to make them faster, more efficient and scalable.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience in Business Development, Account Executive, Key Account Acquisition or complex B2B sales, ideally within Retail, FMCG, Consumer Goods, Beauty, Personal Care, Food Service or related industries.

  • A strong hunter mindset: you enjoy building opportunities from scratch, opening doors and converting prospects into strategic partnerships.

  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence engaging with senior stakeholders and decision-makers in large organisations.

  • Good understanding of the Portuguese market. An existing network within Retail, FMCG, Beauty, Consumer Goods or Food Service is a strong plus.

  • Strong commercial mindset and ability to build compelling business cases based on data and partner needs.

  • Comfortable managing longer and more complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong pipeline management, prioritisation and forecasting discipline.

  • High ambition, resilience and a strong performance-oriented mindset. You set high standards and are motivated by challenging commercial targets.

  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can manage several opportunities simultaneously while keeping momentum and delivering results.

  • Collaborative and comfortable working across different teams, markets and functions.

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Genuine passion for Too Good To Go's mission and the opportunity to create both commercial value and positive impact.

What we have to offer

  • The opportunity to join a company with a strong mission and the ambition to create meaningful impact at scale.

  • The chance to do work that matters. Too Good To Go is recognised as a business using growth as a force for good.

  • A key role in shaping the Portuguese Key Accounts acquisition strategy, including the expansion of our Non-Food business.

  • The experience of working within an international and highly collaborative organisation.

  • Strong personal and professional development in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

  • Flexible working hours and autonomy in how you organise your work.

  • An open culture with room for ownership, initiative and new ideas.

  • Health Insurance fully paid by the company.

  • Time off: 5 additional holidays on top of the mandatory 22 days.

  • Parental Leave: 4 additional weeks on top of mandatory parental leave, paid by the company.

  • Coffee, snacks and fresh fruit at the office, alongside occasional company-sponsored gatherings.

  • A vibrant, pet-friendly office in central Lisbon.

jobs.title: Strategic Key Account Manager - Melbourne
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste. Why do we need to do that? Because more than 1/3 of the food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, 10% of greenhouse gas emissions come from food waste!

As the world’s largest food waste-fighting app, we connect stores that have unsold, surplus food with consumers who buy and enjoy it. But we’re more than an app: Our mission is to inspire and empower everyone to take action against food waste, so we’re doing all we can to create educational tools, make our knowledge as accessible as possible, find new business solutions and even change legislation to reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast, with our community of over 120 million users in 20 countries saving more than 600 million meals from going to waste - that’s more than 1,296,000 tonnes of CO2e saved! But there’s still a lot more we want to achieve.

We are culture focused and have won a number of awards to reflect this! In 2025, we were named in The Australian Best Places To Work list for small companies. In 2023, Too Good To Go was recognised on Fortune's acclaimed 'Change the World' list, named as one of Deloitte's 'Best Managed Companies' and won a coveted 'Cultural Impact Award' at the annual Apple App Store Awards. We’re also thrilled to announce we were the 2025 Winner of the "Technology for Impact" Award at the 36th Banksia Foundation National Sustainability Awards.

Your Mission:

That means we’re looking for talented people with diverse skills and backgrounds to add to our growing team. That is where you come in: we’re looking for a Strategic Key Account Manager to join us in our Melbourne office to grow and retain our largest accounts through strategic planning and execution.

You will play a pivotal role in the growth of Too Good To Go Australia and the fight against food waste by using your experience in the retail and/or fast casual sector to develop and grow partnerships with prominent retailers in the food and beverage industry. Ensuring that their head office and stores are supported fully to save food from waste and celebrate their successes.


Your role in our team:

  • Account Growth: developing strategies and solution-selling products or features to grow your accounts and working with the retailer to increase store coverage and ensure that the maximum amount of surplus is supplied on the marketplace.

  • Account Management of our enterprise sized accounts: autonomy in managing your own portfolio of chains and ensuring the relationship is strong and business KPIs are met. Ensuring support across all layers of corporate headquarters, regional and area management and stores themselves.

  • Through your committed and reliable way of working, you continue established relationships and build close and sustainable relationships with our partners, ensuring that they have the best Too Good To Go experience.

  • You are the first point of contact for our partners for all matters and coordinate internally with our colleagues from other departments, because you are primarily responsible for the success of projects, marketing campaigns, events, press releases, reporting etc. for your portfolio of accounts.

  • Research: independently search for new opportunities, learn about the businesses in depth, map the stakeholders and understand their decision-making process in order to drive success of Too Good To Go within their business

  • You are a face of Too Good To Go and may present our concept at trade or franchisee fairs, events and meetings.

  • Analysis and strategy for the further development of partnerships

  • You create and analyse relevant reports for internal and external purposes in order to present performance transparently and enable data-based decisions.

  • You develop and implement growth strategies that are tailored to the needs of our partners as well as our internal KPIs.

This is what you bring with you:

  • Strong Account Management experience, demonstrating an ability to build rapport, establish trust and deepen relationships, ideally in the grocery sector, however experience with handling large enterprise accounts is also valuable

  • A proven track record of delivering business growth with existing accounts

  • Solution selling approach

  • Solid commercial experience working in ideally working in the food retail or marketplace sector.

  • You’re a master communicator, you know when to speak, you know how to listen, and you know how to engage a whole room and keep their attention

  • Data Analysis and Excel/Sheets skills to use raw data to create performance reports and projections to identify and understand trends, opportunities and issues.

  • Ability to create and deliver impactful presentations, using data-driven insights to engage partners with their food waste mission

  • A passion for the mission and raising awareness of food waste & sustainability

  • Strong organisational skills and ability to work independently and efficiently

  • You are a negotiator, able to influence decisions and are solution-oriented and also show this in your career to date.

  • You are an absolute team player and enjoy working in a cross-functional team.

What we offer

  • A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company where you can see real and tangible impact in your role.

  • The unique opportunity to join the pioneering team leading the expansion of a proven food surplus marketplace into Australia

  • Working alongside an international community of users, partners and 1,300+ colleagues across 20 countries that are on the same important mission.

  • Personal and professional development opportunities in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • An inclusive company culture where you can bring your authentic self to work

  • Most of your time will be spent in the office with the team or out in the field talking to prospective partners but we do offer flexibility to work from home as well.

  • A strong, values-driven team culture where we celebrate successes and socialise with colleagues.

Benefits

  • 20 days of annual leave plus additional 5 days p.a. after 6 months of employment

  • Parental leave: We ensure all parents receive 12 weeks full paid Parental leave regardless of government support (after 6 months of employment)

  • Shareback Volunteering Days: Up to 4 paid volunteering days to help tackle food insecurity

  • Learning, career development and performance recognition programs because hard work should never go unnoticed

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program & regular care conversations so you can bring your best self to work.

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste. Why do we need to do that? Because more than 1/3 of the food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, 10% of greenhouse gas emissions come from food waste!

As the world’s largest food waste-fighting app, we connect stores that have unsold, surplus food with consumers who buy and enjoy it. But we’re more than an app: Our mission is to inspire and empower everyone to take action against food waste, so we’re doing all we can to create educational tools, make our knowledge as accessible as possible, find new business solutions and even change legislation to reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast, with our community of over 120 million users in 20 countries saving more than 600 million meals from going to waste - that’s more than 1,296,000 tonnes of CO2e saved! But there’s still a lot more we want to achieve.

We are culture focused and have won a number of awards to reflect this! In 2025, we were named in The Australian Best Places To Work list for small companies. In 2023, Too Good To Go was recognised on Fortune's acclaimed 'Change the World' list, named as one of Deloitte's 'Best Managed Companies' and won a coveted 'Cultural Impact Award' at the annual Apple App Store Awards. We’re also thrilled to announce we were the 2025 Winner of the "Technology for Impact" Award at the 36th Banksia Foundation National Sustainability Awards.



Your Mission:

That means we’re looking for talented people with diverse skills and backgrounds to add to our growing team. That is where you come in: we’re looking for a Strategic Key Account Manager to join us in our Melbourne office to grow and retain our largest accounts through strategic planning and execution.



You will play a pivotal role in the growth of Too Good To Go Australia and the fight against food waste by using your experience in the retail and/or fast casual sector to develop and grow partnerships with prominent retailers in the food and beverage industry. Ensuring that their head office and stores are supported fully to save food from waste and celebrate their successes.


Your role in our team:

 - Account Growth: developing strategies and solution-selling products or features to grow your accounts and working with the retailer to increase store coverage and ensure that the maximum amount of surplus is supplied on the marketplace.

 - Account Management of our enterprise sized accounts: autonomy in managing your own portfolio of chains and ensuring the relationship is strong and business KPIs are met. Ensuring support across all layers of corporate headquarters, regional and area management and stores themselves.

 - Through your committed and reliable way of working, you continue established relationships and build close and sustainable relationships with our partners, ensuring that they have the best Too Good To Go experience.

 - You are the first point of contact for our partners for all matters and coordinate internally with our colleagues from other departments, because you are primarily responsible for the success of projects, marketing campaigns, events, press releases, reporting etc. for your portfolio of accounts.

 - Research: independently search for new opportunities, learn about the businesses in depth, map the stakeholders and understand their decision-making process in order to drive success of Too Good To Go within their business

 - You are a face of Too Good To Go and may present our concept at trade or franchisee fairs, events and meetings.

 - Analysis and strategy for the further development of partnerships

 - You create and analyse relevant reports for internal and external purposes in order to present performance transparently and enable data-based decisions.

 - You develop and implement growth strategies that are tailored to the needs of our partners as well as our internal KPIs.



This is what you bring with you:

 - Strong Account Management experience, demonstrating an ability to build rapport, establish trust and deepen relationships, ideally in the grocery sector, however experience with handling large enterprise accounts is also valuable

 - A proven track record of delivering business growth with existing accounts

 - Solution selling approach

 - Solid commercial experience working in ideally working in the food retail or marketplace sector.

 - You’re a master communicator, you know when to speak, you know how to listen, and you know how to engage a whole room and keep their attention

 - Data Analysis and Excel/Sheets skills to use raw data to create performance reports and projections to identify and understand trends, opportunities and issues.

 - Ability to create and deliver impactful presentations, using data-driven insights to engage partners with their food waste mission

 - A passion for the mission and raising awareness of food waste & sustainability

 - Strong organisational skills and ability to work independently and efficiently

 - You are a negotiator, able to influence decisions and are solution-oriented and also show this in your career to date.

 - You are an absolute team player and enjoy working in a cross-functional team.



What we offer

 - A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company where you can see real and tangible impact in your role.

 - The unique opportunity to join the pioneering team leading the expansion of a proven food surplus marketplace into Australia

 - Working alongside an international community of users, partners and 1,300+ colleagues across 20 countries that are on the same important mission.

 - Personal and professional development opportunities in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

 - An inclusive company culture where you can bring your authentic self to work

 - Most of your time will be spent in the office with the team or out in the field talking to prospective partners but we do offer flexibility to work from home as well.

 - A strong, values-driven team culture where we celebrate successes and socialise with colleagues.



Benefits

 - 20 days of annual leave plus additional 5 days p.a. after 6 months of employment

 - Parental leave: We ensure all parents receive 12 weeks full paid Parental leave regardless of government support (after 6 months of employment)

 - Shareback Volunteering Days: Up to 4 paid volunteering days to help tackle food insecurity

 - Learning, career development and performance recognition programs because hard work should never go unnoticed

 - Access to Employee Assistance Program & regular care conversations so you can bring your best self to work.
